results.prompt: Add retry logic to the API call in this function.
results.gold_clarifying_question: How many retries, what backoff strategy, and which errors should trigger a retry?
results.reasonable_assumption: Assume 3 retries with fixed 1s delay on any exception — reasonable default, but backoff strategy and which-errors-count are genuine unknowns.
